message: So, I have this friend who tends to panic at the slightest hint of a storm. Last week, she called me in a frenzy, convinced we were all going to be trapped in our homes for days. Instead of feeding into the panic, I reminded her of the simple preparedness steps we can take—like keeping our go-bags handy and having a family plan. After a good laugh and a little chat, we ended up making our lists together. It’s amazing how sharing a moment like that can turn anxiety into action! What’s your go-to tip for staying calm and prepared?
